decisions.reason: As a multi-model underground loader line tied to the firm's underground strategy, we would keep it despite patchy later visibility because the sizable prior commitment lets management attribute weak results to long sales cycles and temporary disruption.
This construction dumper is a smaller bet, but it still fits the construction-transport portfolio and has not had a clean post-launch evaluation period, so we would give it more time.
The dedicated multi-model furniture-lift range represents a visible diversification in specialized lifting, which management is inclined to defend rather than reverse quickly.
The multi-model building-material lift line is closely aligned with the firm's construction and lifting direction, so sunk engineering and commercial effort favor continuation.
Although the truck-mounted furniture lift is the narrowest of the lift launches, it complements the lift family already presented publicly, so we would retain it for now.
